name: fleet
description: Session registry across worktree slots (/fleet), slot lock, port janitor (/ports), session health with cache/context/limits and when each limit window resets (with a notice when the 5-hour window refreshes) and a handoff-and-restart button (/health), a Pull main button, an orchestrator run chip with a % that opens one line per plan, and a [ ⏎ ] button inline after each reply the answer marks with ⏎ (fills the prompt box, unsent).

pushUrl.description: Optional ntfy-style URL to POST phone notifications to (empty = off).
pushUrl.title: Phone push URL

cacheTtlMinutes.description: Prompt-cache lifetime to count down from after each turn (60 on a subscription, 5 on an API key).
cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache TTL (minutes)

heartbeatSeconds.description: How often the session refreshes its registry record and git facts.
heartbeatSeconds.title: Heartbeat (seconds)

autoStopPorts.description: In a wt-N slot, run scripts/slot-stop.mjs when the session ends (skipped while a /remote link is live).
autoStopPorts.title: Stop slot ports on exit

contextWarnPercent.description: Context fill percentage at which the health band appears.
contextWarnPercent.title: Context warning (%)

fePortBase.title: Front-end port base
fePortBase.description: Slot N serves the front end on base + N; the main folder on base. 0 = the base the kit rendered into scripts/lib/slot.mjs (slots.fePorts).

bePortBase.title: Back-end port base
bePortBase.description: Slot N serves the back end on base + N. 0 = the base the kit rendered into scripts/lib/slot.mjs (slots.bePorts).
